records.title: COAL PRODUCTION, TRANSPORT BOTTLENECKS AND SAFETY OF WORKER
details:
The Ministry of Coal has planned to set up 139 first-mile connectivity projects having
1319 MT capacity by FY 2030, comprising of CIL - 92 projects, SCCL - 15 projects, NLCIL
- 5 projects and Captive/Commercial - 27 projects. The planning and commissioning schedule of FMCs are as per production envisaged in the mine plans.
Additionally, the Ministry of Coal, through its coal companies, has undertaken the
planning of 8 major railway line projects. Out of these 8 projects, 5 railway lines are already
commissioned and remaining projects are anticipated to be commissioned by FY 2026-27.
